themes.note: Light tokens on :root, dark tokens on :root[data-theme="dark"]. A head script picks the stored choice or prefers-color-scheme before paint.

display.purpose: Homepage greeting only, a static h1, max 9ch.

headline.purpose: Page titles, max 16ch, balanced. Up to 84px outside inner pages.

title.purpose: Prose section headings; band entries and album titles are sized variants.

title-row.purpose: Work and article row titles beside a right-aligned date.

quote.purpose: Gospel blockquotes in heading color with a hung brick quote mark.

lead.purpose: Page introductions in soft ink, max 34em.

body.purpose: Running text; line height 1.75 and 65ch inside prose.

label.purpose: Nav links, form labels, buttons, resume link.

meta.purpose: Dates, reading time, captions, scripture lists; tabular numerals for dates.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State transitions (nav, links, fields, button) at 200ms.

motion.name: theme-fade
motion.purpose: Crossfade of background, text, band, placeholder, and toggle glyphs on theme change. 0s under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Single breakpoint: grids stack, nav collapses behind Menu.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled action, used for the contact form send button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--olive, #4d5e34); color: var(--sky, #e8d9bf); font-family: var(--font-body, "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--olive, #4d5e34) 82%, var(--ink, #33241a)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brick, #933f2a); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Stacked label over a rounded field with a brick caret and focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink, #33241a); font-family: var(--font-body, "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #cdb995); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--field, #f1e6d2); color: var(--ink, #33241a); font: inherit; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.6; caret-color: var(--brick, #933f2a); transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-soft, #644c3b); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--brick, #933f2a); outline: 2px solid var(--brick, #933f2a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Lora wordmark with soft-ink links; the current page sits over a brick underline.
components.html:
Malcolm Shi

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px 24px; padding-block: 28px; background: var(--sky, #e8d9bf); } .ds-wordmark { margin-right: auto; color: var(--heading, #1f150e); font-family: var(--font-heading, Lora, Georgia, serif); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 20px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 4px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid transparent; color: var(--ink-soft, #644c3b); font-family: var(--font-body, "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink, #33241a); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { border-bottom-color: var(--brick, #933f2a); color: var(--ink, #33241a); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brick, #933f2a); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Sunset Toggle
components.description: Sun with an italic 'click me' hint; sets into a moon and stars in dark mode.
components.css: .ds-sunset { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px 2px 4px 8px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft, #644c3b); cursor: pointer; } .ds-sunset-hint { font-family: var(--font-heading, Lora, Georgia, serif); font-size: 15px; font-style: italic; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-sunset:hover .ds-sunset-hint { color: var(--brick, #933f2a); } .ds-sun { fill: var(--sun, #e3b562); transition: transform 800ms ease; } .ds-sunset:hover .ds-sun { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-sunset:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brick, #933f2a); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-ground { color: var(--ground-soft, #dcd3bc); font-family: var(--font-body, "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif); font-size: 16px; } .ds-hill { display: block; width: 100%; height: 60px; margin-bottom: -1px; } .ds-hill path { fill: var(--ground, #4d5e34); } .ds-band { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px 32px; padding: 20px 32px 40px; background: var(--ground, #4d5e34); } .ds-band-name { color: var(--ground-ink, #f1e6d2); font-family: var(--font-heading, Lora, Georgia, serif); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-band-verse { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; } .ds-band-verse-text { color: var(--ground-ink, #f1e6d2); font-size: 14px; } .ds-band-link { color: var(--ground-ink, #f1e6d2); text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-band-link:hover { color: var(--ground-link, #efcfaa); } .ds-band-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ground-link, #efcfaa); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The page is a landscape. A tan sky fills the top, ink in espresso browns sits on it, and every page ends where an olive hill rolls in and flattens into a ground band that holds the footer. At night the sky turns brown and the ground goes to moss; the hill stays. The structure is the land itself, so content sits in open air on the sky, separated by space and the occasional hairline, and never boxed into cards.

Type does the talking. Lora, a calligraphic old-style serif set at 600, gives headings a hand-made warmth, and Hanken Grotesk at a generous 18px keeps the reading calm. Color is sparing: sienna brick marks things you can follow (links, the current page, the name in the greeting), olive marks the one thing you can press. Photos, until they exist, are irregular soft blobs in a slightly deeper tan, labeled plainly.

One small moment carries the personality: the sun in the header sets into a moon and stars when you switch to dark. Everything else holds still, including the homepage greeting, which is plain type. The site explicitly rejects the split-hero card template, pills, Young Serif, and cream-and-terracotta.
keyCharacteristics: Sky above, ground below: a hill-wave SVG flowing into a solid ground band closes every page.
Light and dark only, switched by `data-theme` on the root, crossfading over 800ms.
Flat. No shadows anywhere; depth comes from the sky and ground planes.
Open rows and space instead of cards; hairline rules where a list needs them.
Lora 600 with negative tracking on every heading, no variation axes; Hanken Grotesk body at 18px.
Soft, asymmetric organic shapes for every photo slot.

rules.name: The Follow and Press Rule
rules.body: Brick means "follow this"; olive means "press this" or "go here next". Never swap them, and never use either as a decorative fill.

rules.name: The Two-Theme Rule
rules.body: Every new color is added as a pair, light on `:root` and dark on `:root[data-theme="dark"]`. There is no system or third theme; the root attribute is always `light` or `dark`.

rules.name: The Band Has Its Own Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on the ground band uses only the `ground-*` tokens. Sky-side tokens (`ink`, `brick`) never appear on the band.

rules.name: The Lora Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings, the wordmark, and the footer name are Lora 600 with negative tracking (-0.015em to -0.03em) that grows with size; quotes and the footer verse are Lora 400. Lora is used as shipped, with no `font-variation-settings`.

rules.name: The Heading Color Rule
rules.body: h1 and h2 take `heading`; h3 takes `ink`. On the band, headings take `ground-ink`.

rules.name: The Flat Land Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows, or raised surfaces. If something needs to stand apart, give it space or move it onto the ground.

rules.name: The No Two Alike Rule
rules.body: Every photo placeholder gets its own irregular radius and aspect ratio (4:5, 5:6, 1:1). Never reuse one shape for a set.

dos: Do define every color as a light and dark pair and read it through `var(--token)`, so the 800ms theme fade carries it.
Do close every page with the hill wave flowing into the ground band, and use only `ground-*` tokens for text on the band.
Do set Lora headings at weight 600 with negative tracking, and leave its variation settings alone.
Do separate content with space and 1px `rule` hairlines.
Do use brick for links and the current page, olive for the single primary action.
Do give every photo slot its own irregular radius and a plain label until a real photo exists.
Do keep motion to the theme fade, 200ms state changes on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and the sunset toggle, all disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep a visible 2px brick focus outline and 44px minimum hit areas on header controls.
donts: Don't use content cards, tiles, or bordered boxes around sections; the only bordered boxes are form controls.
Don't use pill shapes for links, tags, or the current-page marker.
Don't add shadows, glows, or gradients.
Don't build a split-hero card template, or use Young Serif or a cream-and-terracotta scheme.
Don't add a third "system" theme option; the root theme is always `light` or `dark`.
Don't put brick or ink text on the ground band.
Don't add more animated moments; the sunset toggle is the only one.
